title: Efficient extraction of high molecular weight dsDNA from bacterial cell cultures
author: Mitchell G Hedges
materials: Optional (recommended): Quantify the extracted DNA using a 1x dsDNA Broad Range Kit and a sample volume of 5 µL . Following favourable quantification, load 50 ng of DNA with a loading dye onto a 1% TAE agarose gel prepared with 1X SYBR Safe Stain and run at 100V for 01:00:00 to assess DNA quality. Ensure a ladder such as 1kb Extend DNA Ladder (NEB) is used and loaded at the same mass as the DNA samples for visualisation on a trans-UV system such as ChemiDoc.

Metapolyzyme Resuspension Determine the bacterial enzymatic activity (U) per vial using the lot specific Certificate of Analysis as provided by the manufacturer. Reconstitute the vial of lyophilised metapolyzyme to ensure that within a 10 µL volume, at least 5000 U of enzyme is applied. For most batches, reconstituting with approximately 50 µL of 1X PBS (microbial DNA free, Sigma #MBD0058-1ML) ensures a 10 µL dose will contain at least 5000 U of enzyme. Users may wish to optimise the volumes used during reconstitution to ensure a sufficient dose within 10 µL whilst maximising the number of doses from a vial. Place on ice just before use. Store unused aliquots at -20 °C for long term storage as per manufacturers instructions.

steps.title: Prepare 1X PBS solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 10X PBS stock to 1X by adding 33 µL 10X PBS to 297 µL molecular‑grade water in a clean, labelled tube.

steps.title: Prepare 50 mM EDTA solution
steps.instruction: Combine 198 µL molecular‑grade water with 22 µL 0.5 M EDTA to obtain a 50 mM EDTA working solution.

steps.title: Harvest bacterial cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge bacterial culture (1 mL overnight culture or 1 × 10⁶–2 × 10⁹ cells) at 13 000 × g for 1 min, discard the supernatant.

steps.title: First EDTA wash
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 µL 50 mM EDTA, incubate at room temperature for 2 min.

steps.title: Resuspend in ATL and add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL Buffer ATL and 20 µL proteinase K to the pellet, vortex for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 56 °C for 15 min at 500 rpm in a thermomixer; spin down briefly after incubation to remove moisture from tube lids.

steps.title: Second EDTA wash
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL 50 mM EDTA, incubate at room temperature for 2 min, centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 1 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: PBS wash
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL 1X PBS, pipette up/down ten times, pellet at 13 000 × g for 1 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: RNase A treatment (first)
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase A, vortex for 5 seconds, then incubate 15 min at 37 °C, 500 rpm.

steps.title: Centrifuge after RNase A
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 min at 13 000 × g and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add ethanol (first)
steps.instruction: Promptly add 200 µL 96–100 % ethanol to the pellet and vortex thoroughly to obtain a homogeneous solution.

steps.title: Resuspend in PBS (optional)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 90 µL 1X PBS.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate for 15 min at 37 °C, 500 rpm in a thermomixer.

steps.title: Metapolyzyme digestion
steps.instruction: Add >5 000 U Metapolyzyme (≈10 µL), mix by pipetting, and incubate 2 h at 37 °C, 500 rpm (optional extension to 4 h or 24 h).

steps.title: Add proteinase K (second)
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL proteinase K and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Add RNase A (second)
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase A (final 0.2 mg/mL) and pipette‑mix until homogeneous.

steps.title: Incubate at 56 °C (first)
steps.instruction: Incubate 15 min at 56 °C, 500 rpm; spin down after incubation to remove moisture from tube lids.

steps.title: Incubate at 56 °C (second)
steps.instruction: Incubate an additional 30 min at 56 °C (no shaking specified).

steps.title: Add ethanol (second)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 96–100 % ethanol and vortex thoroughly to achieve a homogeneous solution.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL (first)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Buffer AL to the tube and mix by pipetting (or vortex).

steps.title: Add Buffer AL (second)
steps.instruction: Add another 200 µL Buffer AL and mix via pipetting.

steps.title: Add molecular‑grade water
steps.instruction: Add 75 µL molecular‑grade water to the mixture.

steps.title: Incubate 56 °C 2 min
steps.instruction: Incubate for 2 min at 56 °C; if gelatinous debris is present, vortex or pipette with a P200 tip every 2 min to assist lysis.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a labelled silica‑membrane spin column and centrifuge at 6 000 × g for 1 min.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flowthrough (not compatible with bleach) and discard the collection tube.
During centrifugation, aliquot 110 µL (or 60 µL) Buffer AE into a clean, labelled microcentrifuge tube and incubate at 56 °C.

steps.title: Place column in new collection tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a fresh collection tube, discarding used tubes and flowthrough.

steps.title: Wash column with AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Wash Buffer 1 (AW1) to the column, centrifuge at 6 000 × g for 1 min.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flowthrough (do not combine with bleach) and discard the used collection tube.
Place the column in a new, clean collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with AW2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Wash Buffer 2 (AW2) to the column and centrifuge at maximum speed (16 000–20 000 × g) for 1 min.

steps.title: Dry spin column
steps.instruction: Discard the flowthrough (compatible with bleach), replace the column into the collection tube, and spin at maximum speed (16 000–20 000 × g) for 3 min to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA (first)
steps.instruction: Place the column in a labelled 1.5 mL LoBind tube, pipette 100 µL warmed (56 °C) Buffer AE onto the membrane, incubate 56 °C for 1 min, then centrifuge ≥6 000 × g for 1 min to collect eluate.

steps.title: Re‑elute DNA
steps.instruction: Pipette the eluate back onto the membrane, incubate 56 °C for 1 min, and centrifuge ≥6 000 × g for 1 min to obtain a second eluate.

steps.title: Store DNA eluate
steps.instruction: Store the eluate at 2–8 °C in a labelled tube for downstream QA/QC, whole‑genome sequencing or PCR.
